main_text.l: OMNIBVS ARTIS CHYMICÆ STUDIOSIS benè agere.

Quanquam non erat animus pro tenui mea parte ullum scriptum, ullamvè speculationem in rebus Chymicis post disquisitionem de Helia Artista praeterea de me edere, ponderatâ vel inprimis rerum hujuscemodi gravitate: tamen singularis quidam amor ergá eos, qui huic arti proposito Christiano & studio pio adhærent (inter quos & viri Principes) me fateor hûc impulit, ut brevem hanc, sed perspicuam Cheiragogiam Heliam de auro Philosophico, hactenus parum animadversò, committerem luci, eamq; communicarem dignis, etiam atq; etiam studiosè petens, ut eam diligenter pondera-

page.notes: The catchword "re" is the start of the next page's first word (rendered "reliquam" in the original context, shown only as printed). Long s is rendered as plain s. The left-hand fragment of the facing page is not transcribed. Some letters in the body are worn, notably in "Helia" and "animadversò", and should be checked against the scan.
